description: Resilient fetch with automatic fallback. Tries the fast native scraper first, then re-fetches through headless Chromium for client-rendered pages and sites that refuse bare HTTP clients. The response reports which tier served it. Price: $0.008 (70% off when served from cache); an x402 payment is at least $0.004

cache.description: Serve a cached copy when one exists (cached responses are 70% off)

cacheTtl.description: How long to cache this response, in seconds

waitFor.description: CSS selector to wait for (Pro tier only)

name: fetch_resilient
